title: Phir Shaam Me Ek Taaza Qayamat Hui Barpa
body:
Phir Shaam mein ek taaza qayamat hui barpa aye saniye zehra, zalim ne tere farq pa jab belcha maara aye saniye zehra
Qurbaan kiya bhai pa dil bando ko apne farzandoun ko apne, phir unke ke janazoun pa kiya shukr ka sajda aye saniye zehra
Ruqsat hue maidaan ki riza tujh se jo lekar Abbas-e-dilawar, be pardagi ka tujh ko yakeen aagaya hoga aye saniye zehra
Be maqnao chadar sar-e- darbar jo pounchi afat ye nayi thi, tune sar-e- shabbir wahaan tasht mein dekha aaye saniye zehra
<<DIVIDER>>
Yaad aagaye sabko ba khuda Hyder-e-karrar larze darodiwaar, jab Shaam ke darbar mein tune diya qudba aaye saniye zehra
Jis bacchi ke Sarwar the sada naaz utha te seene pa sulate, dam todh te tune usse zindaan main dekha aaye saniye zehra
Kya arz kare aur sayeed-e- jigar figar ab zabt hai dushwaar, likhta hai tera haal to phat ta hai kaleja aaye saniye zehra..
